derivedTask.title: Similar - Link OBJ Bundle
derivedTask.goal: Export one OBJ per named part from a Three.js scene and write a manifest with deterministic ordering and baked geometry statistics.
derivedTask.skillBenefitRationale: The task depends on identifying named Group links, assigning meshes to the nearest named ancestor, expanding InstancedMesh nodes, baking world transforms, and rotating into Blender Z-up space.
